column5: The cars are selected based on statistics. For this, the top 100–200 positions in Rival races are
analyzed to determine which cars appear most frequently.
Only rankings that do not look suspicious are taken into account. Placements by professional players
are given priority. In addition, I perform test drives with the displayed cars and their respective tunings.
The tunings are mostly the same tunings that professional players used for their rankings.
